implemented.shared_stamper: stamp_gate is a deliberately separate owner from generic stamp. It is a literal migration of the gate-specific contract rather than an attempted reuse of generic stamp, whose status fallback and missing-observation behavior differ.
implemented.compatibility_aliases: Each gate retains FIVE_RECORDED_FIELDS and records_five_fields as aliases to the canonical owner, preserving existing module-level access and seven existing __all__ exports without keeping a second implementation.
implemented.coverage: The static gate coverage scanner recognizes sc.stamp_gate, so the migrated gates remain visible as emit-time causality consumers.

preserved_contract.gate_verdict_fields: The helper snapshots and rejects mutation of status, qualification, and a shallow copy of checks. It records a causality verdict beside the gate verdict; it does not replace the gate verdict.
preserved_contract.missing_observation: None, empty string, empty list, and empty mapping are treated as unsupplied. They are passed to emit as an empty observation with blank probe_kind and claim_kind=None, yielding UNTESTED rather than restating PASSED or FAILED.
preserved_contract.optional_fields: The helper writes the five required fields, causality_verdict, and falsifier. It writes top-level probe_kind only for a truthy returned value and claim_kind only for a non-null returned value; an unsupplied observation therefore leaves pre-existing top-level optional labels untouched.
preserved_contract.status_identity: The helper obtains status only from report['status'] and does not adopt the generic stamp fallback to report['id']; it accepts neither a status nor a falsifier keyword.
preserved_contract.payload_ownership: Each gate still owns its distinct causality_payload and exact source string. No qualification logic, report construction, subprocess, network, resident, or model behavior changed.
